title: Goal Reduction with Loop-Removal Accelerates RL and Models Human Brain Activity in Goal-Directed Learning
caption: Fig. 1: A: A schematic view of how a goal-reducer can be integrated with a policy network to generate actions. B: 3 types of subgoal sampling strategies. Red triangles: current states, green squares: goals, light green squares: subgoals sampled. C: An diagram of filtration radius changes trajectory connectivity. D: An example of proper filtered trajectory (black) compared with original random walk (gray) in 3D space.
